Chapter 100: Chapter 1: Choosing Rewards, Different Species (Please Subscribe)

Compared to the team competition rewards,

the individual competition rewards were much more generous, not only in quantity, but also in quality, far surpassing those of the team competition.

Especially for Lin Yuan, who had achieved the number one ranking globally, the rewards were considerable.

“Mr. Lin Yuan, if there is anything on the reward list that you do not understand, you can ask me…”

Standing beside him was a woman dressed in a pink skirt.

Her graceful demeanor made one feel amiable towards her.

On the reward list, there were fifty items.

...

There were high-tech weapons, battleships, spaceships, and the like.

There were also inheritances of Evolution Paths, including the ‘Purple Thunder’ Evolution Path practiced by Thunder God, which was once a top-ranking Evolution Path on Canglan Star.

There were also some cosmic ‘Rare Treasures’, ‘Treasures’ of the starry sky, and uncommon ‘Spiritual Objects’, and so on.

As the champion of the individual competition, Lin Yuan could select five items from the list and had the right of first choice.

That is to say, the fifty items on the list would only be available for other Evolvers to select from after Lin Yuan had made his choices.

According to the competition rules—

The first place could select five items.

The second and third places could select three items.

From the fourth to the tenth place, they could select one item.

“Which five should I choose…”

Lin Yuan was thinking rapidly.

To be honest, Lin Yuan wanted all fifty items on the reward list.

After all, each one was extraordinarily valuable, worth billions, and one couldn’t simply buy them with money; they also required citizen rights and other restrictions.

Even if Lin Yuan himself didn’t need them, he knew many would pay a ‘premium’ price for them.

“Third Rank gene potion? I don’t need it….”

“Fourth Rank orbital cannon… also not needed…”

Lin Yuan continued to eliminate options until he had decided on five.

One: Fourth Rank Life Fruit.

This cosmic Rare Treasure contained an enormous amount of life force, allowing Evolvers below the Fifth Rank to recover quickly from even the most severe injuries, as long as their soul remained.

It was a treasure for preserving life.

Even a Fourth Rank Life Fruit had a certain effect on Fifth Rank Evolvers, remaining effective as long as the injuries were not fatal.

Lin Yuan chose the Life Fruit purely as a precaution against extreme situations, ensuring he had it on hand should he sustain any injuries.

Furthermore,

within the Cosmic Human Alliance, the Life Fruit was highly sought after and always in short supply. Even if Lin Yuan didn’t need it, he could monetize it later on.

Two: The Soul Defense Treasure ‘Soul Suppressing Bell’.

The Soul Suppressing Bell could guard one’s soul and effectively defend against other soul attacks or soul disturbances.

The soul is crucial for life. In the Cosmic Human Alliance, whether one is classified as Human Race is not determined by the physical body, but by the soul.

For example, some cosmic prodigies with great fortunes ‘Seize’ the bodies of some Innate powerful special lifeforms.

Would that cosmic prodigy still count as part of the Human Race?

Or would the offspring of some great figures who switch to a body with superior aptitudes still be considered the descendants of those figures?

The first one counts.

The second one counts as well.

As long as the soul is unique, that is enough.

Three: Jiuli Liquid.

This liquid could enhance one’s physical base strength to a certain extent and was only effective for Evolvers of the Fourth Rank and below.

The soul may be important, but the physical body is essential.

In the Cosmic Human Alliance’s commercial app, Jiuli Liquid can only be hoped to be purchased for fifty billion.

And that is only a hope; as soon as it appears, it is often snapped up immediately.

Four: Soul Nourishing Jade.

Wearing this jade over a long period can subtly increase soul strength.

As for the fifth item, he chose a Sixth Rank Evolution Skill.

This Sixth Rank Evolution Skill, from another Life Planet, seemed from its description to complement Lin Yuan’s Martial Tao Cultivation System significantly.

If Lin Yuan were to purchase it directly, each Evolution Skill would also cost tens of billions.

This Sixth Rank Evolution Skill was almost top-tier among the fifty items.

…

“That will be all.”

Lin Yuan returned the reward list to the lady in the pink skirt.

“Understood.”

The lady’s eyes were gentle. Before she left, she suddenly mentioned, “By the way, Mr. Lin Yuan, there might be news from the Chikun Star Domain after a while…”

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Before the third teleportation,

Lin Yuan had learned from the Goddess of Wisdom that the current platform competition might catch the eye of the Chikun Star Lord.

The Chikun Star Lord was a supreme figure who ruled over an entire Star Domain.

Currently, Canglan Star was also under the jurisdiction of the Chikun Star Domain, one of the million Life Planets within its domain.

Of course, the explanation from the Goddess of Wisdom was very vague.

She only mentioned that it was possible to draw the attention of the Chikun Star Lord and that even if he did, it might not necessarily lead to any reaction.

…

After Lin Yuan had selected his rewards,

the other Evolvers began to choose in turn.

“I pick these three…”

Fang Qing said, his tone somewhat dejected.

In this competition, he had secured second place.

He was only second to Lin Yuan.

Nevertheless, Fang Qing still felt somewhat inadequate.

Mainly because the gap in strength between him and Lin Yuan was too great. If either Thunder God or Yang Wei had secured second place,

he would have accepted it, feeling that he had hope of catching up.

The white-bearded old man sitting on his shoulder then shook his head and said, “Fang kid, you really don’t need to reproach yourself. That Lin Yuan kid may have some talent indeed, but the Evolution Path he practices surely can’t compare to the ‘Ancient God’ Evolution Path.”

“He might be ahead of you now, and perhaps he will lead you in ten years, or even several decades, but after a hundred or several hundred years, he will certainly not catch up to you.”
